entries.name: NA-931 alone and with tirzepatide
entries.stage: Phase 2 registry not yet recruiting; later Phase 3 programme sponsor-reported
entries.summary: The sponsor describes oral NA-931 as a quadruple IGF-1, GLP-1, GIP and glucagon receptor agonist and reports a Phase 3 programme. A separate sponsor-submitted Phase 2 registry record plans NA-931 alone and with weekly tirzepatide in an estimated 224 adults with overweight or obesity, including body-weight, body-composition and physical-function measures.
entries.ukAuthorisation: The reviewed sponsor and registry evidence does not establish UK marketing authorisation for NA-931, alone or with tirzepatide.
entries.nhsEngland: No NICE recommendation or NHS England access is established by the reviewed evidence.
entries.supply: Sponsor announcements and trial records do not establish lawful UK retail supply, pharmacy stock or a product sold by Shift Some Timber.
entries.limitations: The Phase 2 registry was last updated 27 March 2026, remains not yet recruiting, has no posted results and retains an already-past 15 August 2026 estimated start. The sponsor's later Phase 3 and lean-mass statements are attributed claims, not registry-posted results, regulatory findings or proof that every planned study has started. No efficacy, safety, superiority or muscle-preservation conclusion is drawn here.
